w:r.w:t: 7 Erector Events, Dead Letter Queue Handlers, Validation Health Check

The main Prompt 8 builds the event system, dead letter queue, and system health. The Erector introduced 7 new events that the existing event registry does not know about. This prompt registers them, adds dead letter queue handlers for Erector failures, and adds a system health check that monitors the validation pipeline.
Run this prompt AFTER the main Prompt 8 is verified working.
Read the existing event registry — identify exactly where events are defined and how workers are registered for them.
Read the existing dead letter queue handler — understand the current failure pattern before adding new ones.
Read the existing SystemHealthWorker — understand the current check structure before adding a new check.
Addition 1 — Register 7 Erector events in the event registry

Add these 7 events to the event type registry. Each needs a worker registered in WorkerRegistry.ts. The workers are lightweight — they log, update status fields, and emit follow-on events where required.
Create ValidationRun record. Set validation_stage = 'running'. Log to EventLog.
Update validation record with archetype_resolution JSON. Log archetype name and multipliers.
Log engine name, success flag, fallback_used flag to EventLog. Update engine completion count on ValidationRun.
Set validation_stage = 'complete'. Update blueprint draft status to 'path_selection'. Emit notification to user.
Set validation.selected_path. Set validation.recommended_blueprint_level. Trigger first week plan generation.
Confirm first_week_plan JSON is stored on validation record. Log task_count and smoke_test_count.
Confirm 7 smoke test tasks exist in orders table. Confirm archetype fields locked on blueprint. Log launch telemetry.

Addition 3 — System health check: validation pipeline
Add a validation pipeline health check to the SystemHealthWorker. This check runs every 5 minutes alongside existing health checks and verifies the Erector pipeline is not stuck.
